decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management lies very close to the firm's core ship management expertise, so the firm can readily interpret results and refine the service, and it is consistent with its strategy of broadening scope toward energy markets.

Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's large crew management operations, giving it strong related knowledge to assimilate feedback, although pandemic disruption to travel adds some uncertainty.

The online vessel information portal builds on the firm's operational data and customer relationships, and its digital elements can be improved through industry cooperation, though the firm's limited in-house R&D makes digital products somewhat riskier.

The vessel performance app draws on the firm's operations and sustainability knowledge and fits its goal of cleaner shipping, but it is further from core service know-how and has weaker in-house R&D behind it, so the drop risk is moderately higher.
